title: Festival of Chinese Saoc 2nd time
summary: The village of Sa Réc (The Tower) puts on itself bright colors with hundreds of species of flowering affiliates.
body:
The Kingdom of Flowers in the heart of the West

The second flowered Festival Sa Réc took place from 27/12 to 4/1, aggregating 20 main operations and 12 activities responded with numerous impressive flower-views.

Tourists can visit the flower village, take photos and flower gardens, the experience of making paper flowers, and enjoy the western specialty.

Set the Sa Réc village tour one day with TodayTourist: the pick-up car, the dedicated guide.
